subject: Ops sprint: procurement onramp gap analysis & MAP
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@novushealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Discovery w/ Novus Health — procurement path & next steps

Thanks again for the productive call this morning, Laura — quick recap and suggested mutual action plan (MAP) so your procurement team has a single view of next steps.

High-level:
- Novus expressed preference for a PO-backed purchase but mentioned possibility of using the Azure Marketplace if internal approval is slow.
- Primary gating stages we heard: Legal review -> Security review (SOC2 evidence) -> Finance vendor setup -> PO issuance.

Immediate asks for procurement prep (low lift):
1) Confirm the purchase instrument you expect to use (PO v. card v. marketplace).
2) Share your standard vendor setup form and any SLA/contract redline contacts.
3) Key milestone target dates for legal/security/finance so we can align internal resources.

Proposed MAP (first pass):
- Legal review complete: 2027-06-07
- Security evidence & questions closed: 2027-06-14
- Finance vendor setup & PO issuance: 2027-06-21

Attachments I’ve included: MAP-NovusHealth-v1.pdf (first draft MAP) and Redwood-Security-Factsheet.pdf (SOC2 summary + data handling). We can add a short SOW if you’d like to accelerate procurement.

If PO is the route, we’ll prepare a short SOW and the commercial term sheet for your legal/finance teams to review. If you prefer the Marketplace path we can outline what metadata and billing setup you’ll need.

Would you be available for a 20-min procurement sync on Wed, June 2nd at 10am PT? If not, suggest an alternate.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a draft SOW after procurement confirms the instrument.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com
Attachment: MAP-NovusHealth-v1.pdf (12 KB)
Attachment: Redwood-Security-Factsheet.pdf (84 KB)
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@novushealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@novushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Discovery w/ Novus Health — procurement path & next steps

Kimberly — thanks for the clear recap and fast turnaround. A couple of answers and a few asks from our side: 

1) We are leaning strongly toward a PO (Finance requires a PO for any >$10k ARR commitments).
2) I’ve looped in procurement (procurement@novushealth.com) — their vendor setup typically requires: W9, vendor questionnaire, banking details, and an internal security checklist.
3) Can you share a short SOW and an example commercial term sheet (no longer than 2 pages)? Procurement will want to see term language around data residency and liability caps upfront.

Also — does Redwood accept DocuSign/e-signature for SOWs, or do you require a signed PO before provisioning?

Appreciate the proposed timeline. We are targeting an internal legal kickoff the week of 6/7 but won’t have final PO until late June if there are redlines. If Redwood can stage access ahead of PO (trial account / sandbox access with data controls) that would help our security team validate integration earlier.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Chen
Director, Product & AI | Novus Health
laura.chen@novushealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Recap: Discovery w/ Novus Health — procurement path & next steps (internal)

Kimberly / Vivek — quick internal note after reading Laura’s reply. Action items and suggested adjustments to the MAP to keep the timeline realistic given vendor setup delays we typically see: 

Quick notes:
- PO route confirmed by Laura; that usually adds 2–3 weeks for vendor setup in healthcare orgs because of W9 + banking verification.
- Procurement will require SOC2 evidence plus answers to a short security questionnaire (we have a standard packet).

Suggested MAP v2 (internal):
- Legal kickoff / initial review: 2027-06-07 (owner: Legal - Emily)
- Security questionnaire returned: 2027-06-11 (owner: Redwood security)
- SOC2 evidence packet sent: 2027-06-11 (owner: Redwood security)
- Procurement vendor setup complete: 2027-06-18 (owner: Novus procurement)
- PO received: 2027-06-25 (owner: Novus finance)

Proposed next steps (owners):
- Kimberly: Send 1-page commercial term sheet + short SOW by EOD 5/24.
- Vivek: Pull SOC2 summary + security questionnaire and send to Laura’s procurement (target 5/25).
- Ben: Escalate to marketplace partner team if procurement asks for Marketplace path — good fallback to accelerate onboarding.

I’ve attached a short SOW (SOW-NovusHealth-draft.docx) we can use as a template; Kimberly, feel free to edit commercial terms.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
Attachment: SOW-NovusHealth-draft.docx (9 KB)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@novushealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@novushealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 18:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Discovery w/ Novus Health — procurement path & next steps

Laura / Procurement team — thanks for the quick reply and for confirming the likely PO path. Attached is the 1-page commercial term sheet and a short SOW draft for your review (SOW-NovusHealth-draft.docx). We’ve also attached our SOC2 summary and a brief security questionnaire so procurement can run that in parallel with legal.

Updated MAP (v2) — baked in vendor-setup buffer per Ben’s note:
- Legal kickoff / initial review: 2027-06-07 (Novus legal; contact: TBD)
- Security questionnaire returned + SOC2 packet delivered: 2027-06-11 (Redwood security / Novus security)
- Procurement vendor setup complete: 2027-06-18 (Procurement)
- PO issuance: 2027-06-25 (Finance)

Options to accelerate:
- If procurement is willing to accept a signed SOW + e-signature (DocuSign), we can provision a sandbox account with strict data controls for your security team to validate integration prior to PO.
- If PO timing looks likely to slip, we can route through Azure Marketplace — Vivek can connect your marketplace ops to outline metadata & billing steps.

Next concrete steps: 
- Kimberly: Send commercial term sheet & SOW (attached) — done.
- Vivek: Sending SOC2 packet and completed security questionnaire tomorrow (5/25).
- Procurement: Share vendor setup form + expected date for vendor onboarding.

Please respond with preferred option for staging access (signed SOW w/ e-sign v. waiting for PO v. Marketplace). If helpful, we can hold a 20-minute procurement onboarding call on Wed, June 2 at 10am PT — I’ll send a calendar invite once I hear back.

Appreciate the fast movement here.

Best regards,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com
Attachments: SOW-NovusHealth-draft.docx (9 KB); Redwood-Security-Factsheet.pdf (84 KB)
